comment: Where each artifact tree is published, relative to the site base. Read by src/integrations/artifacts.mjs, which copies them, and by tests/test_artifacts.py, which checks that every $id matches the URL it lands at. One file because the two must not disagree: a relative $ref resolves against the $id of the file it appears in, not against wherever you fetched it, so a schema served anywhere other than the path its own $id names has references that resolve to nothing.
